description: NAM-002 (RFC-010 Part 3): machine-readable reservation of every token used outside the six canonical field namespaces — rule-ID family prefixes, cross-repo ID prefixes, and six-field codes explicitly barred from reuse as prefixes. Extends NAM-001: NAM-001 makes collisions inside the six-field namespaces impossible; NAM-002 closes the cross-artifact loop (the State-HL/Action-HL and POL collision class, generalized). Retired tokens stay reserved forever, mirroring rule-ID permanence.
governance: Editor-controlled for v1.x. A new rule family or cross-repo prefix MUST be added here before first use; the validator rejects unregistered rule-ID prefixes.

kinds.rule_family: Prefix of validation/governance rule IDs (SEM-015, TRG-001, ...).
kinds.id_prefix: Prefix of non-rule identifiers owned by a repo or suite (MC-006, W3, SBL-9).
kinds.six_field_alias: Declared relation to a six-field code (TRG is the rule family FOR Action TR). The relation is registered, not accidental.
kinds.prohibited_prefix: A six-field code permanently barred from reuse as any prefix or artifact token.

entries.note: Also Origin LEG — declared alias: the LEG rule family governs LEG-origin events.
